# Keybindings

Every row below is rendered from `hypr/config/software/keybinds.lua` by the
same parse that `Super + H` shows at runtime, so this file cannot disagree with
the bindings it documents. To change a binding, edit the config and regenerate:

```bash
./scripts/docs/generate-keybindings.sh
```

`test/test-docs.sh` fails when this file is out of date, so a stale copy cannot
be committed.

Two rows name a file rather than an application. `Super + Enter` and
`Super + B` run whatever `options/terminal` and `options/browser` contain, read
at Hyprland's parse time, so the answer is per-machine and the Super + H
overlay fills in your own. Everything else here is the same on every
checkout.

## Applications

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `Super + Enter` | Terminal (`options/terminal`) |
| `Super + E` | File manager (`options/filemanager`) |
| `Super + N` | Text editor (`options/editor`) |
| `Super + T` | Notes (Obsidian) |
| `Super + B` | Web browser (`options/browser`) |
| `Super + S` | Screenshot a region |
| `Super + Alt + S` | Screenshot a region and annotate |
| `Super + Shift + S` | Capture bar: screenshot |
| `Super + Shift + R` | Capture bar: record, or stop |
| `Super + Shift + E` | New calendar event |
| `Super + G` | Code editor (`options/codeeditor`) |
| `Super + K` | Calculator |
| `Super + A` | AI assistant sidebar |
